summary: Partition Flipp flyer, merchant, and cached item storage, sync checkpoints, local reads, searches, MCP search, and archive by explicit postal code and locale; keep no-market clipping reads live-only and reject any advertised extra page.
reason: The same API ID can describe different markets; a default postal code or unscoped database key can overwrite one market with another, and an archive that requests no resources or misses nested pagination metadata falsely reports success.
